title: Workflow Envelope
$comment: Authoritative stage-1 workflow envelope contract. This schema is the only owner for serialized workflow envelopes, workflow-embedded approvals[], and approval-record anchor semantics. No separate approval schema owner or approval artifact namespace exists.

approvals.$comment: In-envelope approval history. This schema owns per-record structure (approval_id, boundary_id, decision enum, decided_at format, and confirmation anchors). Same-boundary temporal supersession is not expressible in JSON Schema and is owned by the semantic validator: group approvals by boundary_id, order by decided_at, select the latest valid winner, fail closed on equal-timestamp conflicts, and block a stale approved decision when a newer revoked/rejected/invalid decision exists.

canonicalWorkflowId.$comment: Canonical workflow IDs are owned by registry/routing-gate-registry.json; this schema mirrors that registry-owned set for envelope binding only.

teacherConfirmationAnchor.$comment: Teacher-confirmation anchors are transcript or handoff references inside the same serialized envelope. No external approval artifact namespace exists.

approvalRecord.$comment: Minimum in-envelope approval record. Approval confirmation anchors are fail-closed and may not recurse through approval-record. This schema owns approval shape; there is no separate approval artifact namespace.

license_authority.description: AR-1 separation field. Distinguishes an intrinsically public license from a teacher-authorized use of public school disclosure. Optional and non-breaking; when present it must not weaken the fail-closed status gate.
